name: Balanced lookahead rounds, Sklansky
description: The circuit of Balanced lookahead rounds with Sklansky carry trees for every sum of the rounds, the schedule and its rewind, in place of Brent-Kung trees where depth mattered less. It is a little shallower and uses more Toffolis: 1,113 qubits, 98,202 Toffolis, reaction depth 717. Every AND is computed once into a qubit of its own and measured away, and registers are cleared by an X-basis measurement with the phase fixed on the bits of a second sum.
